title: AMD buys AI server builder ZT Systems for $4.9B

sources.quote: AMD has agreed to acquire ZT Systems in a cash and stock transaction valued at $4.9 billion, inclusive of a contingent payment of up to $400 million based on certain post-closing milestones.

explain: AMD paid cash and stock for ZT Systems, a New Jersey company that designs and builds rack-scale AI servers for the biggest cloud companies, to help it sell complete AI systems against Nvidia. The $4.9 billion includes up to $400 million that depends on later milestones. The deal closed in March 2025; AMD later sold ZT's factory business to Sanmina.
